Scrapes a simple HTML page and extracts title, description, and links

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using Crawlberg;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var engineConfig = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<CrawlConfig>("{\"max_depth\":0,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}", ConfigOptions)!;
var engine = CrawlbergConverter.CreateEngine(engineConfig);
var url = "https://example.com";
var result = await CrawlbergConverter.ScrapeAsync(engine, url);
Console.WriteLine(result.StatusCode);
Console.WriteLine(result.ContentType);
Console.WriteLine(result.Html);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.Title);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.Description);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.CanonicalUrl);
Console.WriteLine(result.Links.Count);
Console.WriteLine(result.Links[0].LinkType);
Console.WriteLine(result.Images.Count);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.OgTitle);
```
